title: For the Ladies: 10 Romance Shows Like The Summer I Turned Pretty
description: countdown for the ladies: 10 romance series for anyone who fell for The Summer I Turned Pretty, from #10 up to #1. Open with a  hook: if you are still not over Team Conrad or Team Jeremiah, these ten shows will give you the same butterflies, and number one is the one that started it all. Then go straight in. (1) the leads and the characters they play, and the streamer; (2) the setup in two or three concrete sentences: who she is, who he is (or who they are), the love triangle or obstacle, and what is at stake; (3) why it gives you butterflies: the slow burn, the swoon moment, the chemistry, the drama. Mention the vibe (summer romance, period drama, small town, college, enemies to lovers, first love) so viewers can pick their favourite, and how many seasons are out. Use the most romantic moments from the trailers for the hooks: almost-kisses, kisses, lingering looks, the big dramatic moment. Warm, fun, a little dramatic, like talking to your best friend. No spoilers about who ends up with whom. Outro: ask viewers which couple they are rooting for, and invite them to subscribe for more lists for the ladies.
movies: Off Campus (2026); Heartstopper (2022); Outlander (2014); Virgin River (2019); Nobody Wants This (2024); Maxton Hall - The World Between Us (2024); XO, Kitty (2023); My Life with the Walter Boys (2023); Wayne (2019); Never Have I Ever (2020)
